summary: Test-writing phase for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with generated OpenAPI Swift client). Committed red-phase permanent tests pinning the generated-client contract, wrapper API, and vendored OpenAPI document, plus the migration plan documenting verified contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the real published API (viamin/color_matching#113, closes #110). Swift tests could not be executed locally: the Linux container has no Swift toolchain, and the generated ColorMatchingAPI module does not exist until the implementation run lands; verification is deferred to macOS CI at the implementation PR head. Expected red-phase failures: the three tests referencing ColorMatchingAPI/OpenAPIRuntime fail to build until implementation; VendoredOpenAPIDocumentTests compiles today and fails at runtime until iOS/Sources/ColorMatchingAPI/openapi.yaml exists.

acceptance_criteria.description: swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime added to the iOS package; OpenAPI document fetched or vendored from viamin/color_matching#110

references.reason: Compiles today; fails at runtime because iOS/Sources/ColorMatchingAPI/openapi.yaml does not exist yet (red phase). No Swift toolchain in this Linux container to execute it.

Pins exact package dependencies (swift-openapi-generator 1.14+, swift-openapi-runtime 1.13+, swift-openapi-urlsession), target/module names, vendored document path, and the full vendored YAML validated to parse with all 6 operations and 29 schemas resolving.

acceptance_criteria.description: Generate the client for the surfaces the app uses today: test-sheet manifest + recent sheets, capture session creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results

references.reason: Red phase: test references the not-yet-generated ColorMatchingAPI module, so the target fails to build until the implementation run lands. Cannot execute locally (no Swift toolchain).

Vendored YAML defines all six operationIds (getTestSheetManifest, listRecentTestSheets, getRankedResults, createCapture, uploadMeasurements, uploadJudgments) with status codes matching the published server spec.

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace the app's hand-written API models with generated types; keep purely client-side models as-is

references.reason: Red phase: pins the ColorMatchingAPIClient wrapper API (generated types at the boundary, MeasurementCore domain models kept client-side). Cannot execute locally (no Swift toolchain; wrapper not yet implemented).

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift tests exercising the generated client against local stubbed responses (no live server in CI)

references.reason: StubTransport + fixtures provide fully offline stubbed responses for all tests; execution deferred to CI (no Swift toolchain in this container).

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec, and endpoint gaps discovered

references.reason: Contains the delta table (prose vs published spec vs actual server, derived from viamin/color_matching@main api_schemas.ex, test_sheet_json.ex, capture_controller.ex, capture_upload.ex) and a six-item endpoint-gap list intended for the PR body; the PR body itself is written when the implementation run opens the PR.

acceptance_criteria.description: Exit criterion: swift test --disable-sandbox green with generated types wired in

references.reason: Deferred to macOS CI at the implementation PR head; this environment has no Swift toolchain and the generated module does not exist yet (test-writing phase).
